COR.title: Common Stock, $0.01 par value per share

scope: Distinct accession and context with a nonempty TradingSymbol; exact context joins to nonempty title and exchange facts.
limitations: Counts are filing contexts, not distinct securities, companies, a coverage percentage or a validated universe.
An exact context join does not prove that a title, ticker and exchange are correct or describe one security.
Some filers report several classes for the same symbol; ticker changes and effective dates require separate verification.
Filing date is not a public-availability timestamp; this retrospective SEC archive may have been revised.
No stock returns or investment-growth targets were calculated.
